flora: Taxodium cone (woody, globose cone with rugose, shield-shaped scales)
Alternate needles (flat, linear needles arranged alternately along the twig, distinct from Metasequoia)
Taxodium sapling (slender, upright with emerging feathery green needles)
Cypress Knee (close-up of a woody pneumatophore protruding from the mud)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'alternate' arrangement of needles to differentiate from Dawn Redwoods; focus on the unique textures of the woody 'knees'; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single woody globose cone; Top-Right: High-detail view of the alternate needle arrangement; Bottom-Left: A young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of a 'cypress knee' rising from the mud.
visual_logic.ground: Saturated, dark organic mudstone with small brown siltstone fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to emphasize the botanical differences in needle attachment.
